description: Measures peak double-precision (FP64) floating-point compute throughput using a long chain of fused multiply-add (FMA) instructions via fma(). All values live in registers; reports GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: fmas_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of FMA operations per thread per kernel invocation; controls total compute work

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: num_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed kernel launches for averaging
